officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Pune district administration and the Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh department; Chakan is in Pune district. No Chakan-local parcel endpoint or office response was qualified.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreService: NIC Bhu-Naksha is the national cadastral-mapping platform documentation/implementation reference; the Maharashtra deployment is linked as Mahabhunakasha.
officialSourceAssessment.stateParcelService: Government of Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh / Mahabhumi official land-records portal and Mahabhunakasha viewer.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: The official state service page explicitly links Mahabhunakasha as the map-with-land-records service, and the official Pune district page links Maharashtra land-record services. This supports registryFound=true as source discovery only, not adapter qualification or citywide coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: An official Maharashtra cadastral/map service and official Pune district land-record custodian are evidenced by first-party pages, although the map host was unavailable for bounded anonymous feature inspection.
